reading: Negotiations, or formal discussions, at the COP31 climate meeting in Turkey continued more than a day beyond the planned finish.
Countries had still not agreed on a global climate agreement, so the discussions were suspended, or stopped temporarily, for the night.
The EU and Pacific island nations opposed a draft agreement, an unfinished version, because it did not mention reducing fossil fuel demand.
Ministers from several countries and the EU wanted the final agreement to include a commitment to move away from oil, gas and coal.
Fossil fuel producers, led by Saudi Arabia, had pushed to remove that commitment from the agreement.
The Africa Group wanted commitments, or firm promises, to provide more money for adaptation, which means preparing for climate change's effects.
The EU had previously said it would not support this request for more adaptation money.
An earlier draft included a target of $120 billion for adaptation by 2035, but this amount was later removed.
Some teams were moving their Sunday flights to Monday, suggesting that an agreement was still some distance away.
If countries do not reach consensus, meaning agreement among all participants, the negotiations could be suspended.
In that case, the meeting would end without an agreement and continue next year.
However, the UK's chief negotiator remained hopeful and said her team was still trying to reach an agreement.
Another risk was that too many teams might leave, leaving too few countries to approve a global agreement.

vocabulary.definition: Formal discussions in which people or groups try to reach an agreement.
Stopped temporarily, with the possibility of continuing later.
An unfinished version of an agreement that people can still discuss and change.
The amount of something that people need or want to use.
Gradually stop using or depending on something.
Firm promises to take particular actions.
Changes that help people prepare for and manage the effects of climate change.
Agreement among all the people or groups taking part in a discussion.

entries.ja: 人や集団が合意に達しようとして行う正式な話し合い。
entries.ko: 사람들이나 집단이 합의에 이르기 위해 나누는 공식적인 논의.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们或团体为达成一致而进行的正式讨论。

entries.pt-BR: Discussões formais em que pessoas ou grupos tentam chegar a um acordo.
entries.fr: Discussions officielles au cours desquelles des personnes ou des groupes essaient de parvenir à un accord.
entries.de: Formelle Gespräche, in denen Personen oder Gruppen versuchen, eine Einigung zu erzielen.

entries.ja: 後で再開する可能性を残して、一時的に中断された状態。
entries.ko: 나중에 다시 이어질 가능성을 남겨 두고 일시적으로 중단된 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 暂时停止，但之后仍有可能继续。
entries.es: Detenido temporalmente, con la posibilidad de continuar más adelante.
entries.pt-BR: Interrompido temporariamente, com a possibilidade de continuar mais tarde.
entries.fr: Interrompu temporairement, avec la possibilité de reprendre plus tard.
entries.de: Vorübergehend unterbrochen, mit der Möglichkeit, später fortgesetzt zu werden.

entries.ja: まだ話し合ったり変更したりできる、未完成の合意文書。
entries.ko: 아직 논의하거나 수정할 수 있는 미완성 합의문.
entries.zh-Hans: 尚未完成、仍可讨论和修改的协议版本。
entries.es: Versión aún no terminada de un acuerdo que todavía se puede debatir y modificar.
entries.pt-BR: Versão ainda não concluída de um acordo que as pessoas ainda podem discutir e modificar.
entries.fr: Version non définitive d’un accord qui peut encore être discutée et modifiée.
entries.de: Eine noch nicht fertige Fassung einer Vereinbarung, die noch besprochen und geändert werden kann.

entries.ja: 人々が必要とする、または使いたいと思うものの量。
entries.ko: 사람들이 필요로 하거나 사용하고 싶어 하는 어떤 것의 양.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们需要或想要使用的某种事物的数量。
entries.es: Cantidad de algo que las personas necesitan o quieren utilizar.
entries.pt-BR: Quantidade de algo que as pessoas precisam usar ou querem usar.
entries.fr: Quantité de quelque chose dont les gens ont besoin ou qu’ils souhaitent utiliser.
entries.de: Die Menge von etwas, die Menschen benötigen oder nutzen möchten.

entries.ja: 何かを使うことや何かに頼ることを、徐々にやめること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 사용하거나 그것에 의존하는 일을 점차 그만두는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 逐渐停止使用或依赖某种事物。
entries.es: Dejar gradualmente de utilizar algo o de depender de ello.
entries.pt-BR: Deixar gradualmente de usar algo ou de depender disso.
entries.fr: Cesser progressivement d’utiliser quelque chose ou d’en dépendre.
entries.de: Nach und nach aufhören, etwas zu nutzen oder davon abhängig zu sein.

entries.ja: 特定の行動を取るという固い約束。
entries.zh-Hans: 采取特定行动的坚定承诺。
entries.es: Promesas firmes de realizar determinadas acciones.
entries.pt-BR: Promessas firmes de realizar determinadas ações.
entries.fr: Promesses fermes de mener des actions précises.
entries.de: Feste Zusagen, bestimmte Maßnahmen zu ergreifen.

entries.ja: 人々が気候変動の影響に備え、対処するのに役立つ変化。
entries.ko: 사람들이 기후 변화의 영향에 대비하고 대처하는 데 도움이 되는 변화.
entries.zh-Hans: 帮助人们为气候变化的影响做好准备并加以应对的调整。
entries.es: Cambios que ayudan a las personas a prepararse para los efectos del cambio climático y a afrontarlos.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças que ajudam as pessoas a se preparar para os efeitos das mudanças climáticas e a lidar com eles.
entries.fr: Changements qui aident les gens à se préparer aux effets du changement climatique et à y faire face.
entries.de: Veränderungen, die Menschen helfen, sich auf die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels vorzubereiten und damit umzugehen.

entries.ja: 話し合いに参加しているすべての人や集団の間で意見が一致すること。
entries.ko: 논의에 참여하는 모든 사람이나 집단 사이에 의견이 일치하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 参与讨论的所有人或团体之间达成的一致意见。
entries.es: Acuerdo entre todas las personas o grupos que participan en una discusión.
entries.pt-BR: Acordo entre todas as pessoas ou grupos que participam de uma discussão.
entries.fr: Accord entre toutes les personnes ou tous les groupes qui participent à une discussion.
entries.de: Übereinstimmung zwischen allen Personen oder Gruppen, die an einer Diskussion teilnehmen.
